(rule!
  ;; The two maroon markers encode one row-major translation vector.
  (let* ((markers (find-color g 9))
         (p1 (first markers))
         (p2 (second markers))
         (dr (- (fst p2) (fst p1)))
         (dc (- (snd p2) (snd p1))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        ;; Pull from one vector-step behind; this overlays the shifted copy.
        (let* ((sr (- r dr))
               (sc (- c dc))
               (src-v (if (in-bounds? sr sc h w) (cell-at g sr sc) 0))
               (v (cell-at g r c)))
          (cond
            [(and (not (= src-v 0)) (not (= src-v 9))) src-v]
            ;; Otherwise retain original payload cells and erase both markers.
            [(and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9))) v]
            [else 0]))))))
